text:
sarah_support: FYI — Customer (NexaHealth) emailed procurement policy: they will not accept an invoice unless we have their official PO number and internal authorization code. They specifically call out SAP vendor code & cost center. Copy of their email pasted below.

jordan_sales: thanks, can you paste the exact wording from their procurement email? need to know whether this is a hard block or negotiable.

sarah_support: pasted: "Per our procurement policy, invoices must include an approved Purchase Order (PO) number and the 6-digit authorisation code. Without these we cannot process invoices in SAP — payment will be delayed. Vendor registration (W-9 + VAT cert) must be complete." They also attached a vendor onboarding form.

julia_procurement: tagging from procurement side — this is a standard enterprise requirement. We can request a PO from the customer but we do not issue a payable invoice until we have the PO on file.

alan_billing: quick options: 1) ask customer for an official PO number and cost center (preferred), 2) provide a pro-forma invoice while they issue PO (note: pro-forma won't trigger payment workflow in SAP), 3) if customer can pay by card immediately we can accept CC payment without invoice (needs sales sign-off).

mike_cust_finance: we already told them we can provide a pro-forma, but their AP team said they 'cannot accept anything other than an official PO + invoice pair'. they did ask if we can be added as a pre-approved vendor in their SAP portal — they attached vendor registration link.

jordan_sales: can we get a short-term workaround? if they add us as a vendor and upload W-9/VAT docs, will that speed issuance of the PO?

julia_procurement: yes, vendor onboarding typically precedes PO creation. I can send them the vendor packet and a checklist of required fields we need back (PO number, authoriser name + code, cost center). If we get those things, billing can create an invoice with the PO# in the header.

alan_billing: Sarah — can you request the following from the customer in one message: 1) official PO number, 2) 6-digit authorization code, 3) cost center/SAP GL code, 4) completed vendor registration (W-9 or VAT cert), 5) point of contact in AP. Also ask whether they'd accept a pro-forma in the meantime.

sarah_support: sending that now. drafting: "Hi — we can proceed once we have the official PO and vendor docs. To help you complete onboarding quickly can you confirm the 6-digit authorization code and cost center, and upload the W-9/VAT to your vendor portal? If you need a pro-forma to start payment approvals we can provide one, but please note it is not an invoice for payment in SAP." Want me to CC sales?

jordan_sales: please CC me. i'll also offer a one-time exception for card payment if they need immediate clearance (we'd need exec approval).

mike_cust_finance: if you provide a pro-forma that contains line-item price and PO placeholder, that helps our AP team to create the PO quicker. they prefer to see the SOW line items and costs.

julia_procurement: note: make sure SOW/term dates match the PO period — mismatch causes PO rejection in their SAP workflow. ask customer to confirm contract period.

billing_bot: Billing task created: #BILL-4821 — pending customer PO and vendor docs. Assigned to alan_billing.

alan_billing: noted. i'll hold invoice issuance until we have PO on file per their policy. if we get vendor docs + PO within 5 business days, i'll issue a normal invoice referencing PO#. If not, we can discuss pro-forma + card payment route with sales.

sarah_support: customer replied: they want a single consolidated invoice for the quarter and insist PO must be created before any invoice. they asked if we can 'pre-register' with their SAP so procurement can expedite. they included vendor portal link and the AP contact.

jordan_sales: i'll reach out to AP contact with a short packet (W-9, company info, sample invoice template). Julia — can you draft the vendor packet and checklist?

julia_procurement: will do. i'll include a note about matching SOW dates and the exact field mapping they need in PO header (PO#, authorisation code, cost center).

mike_cust_finance: also asked about VAT handling for EU entity — do we have VAT certificate for our EU subsidiary? need to send that too.

sarah_support: alan — any dependency on VAT docs for US invoicing?

alan_billing: for US customers VAT isn't required, but since they mentioned EU tax we should include our VAT cert (if EU billing will be used) to speed vendor onboarding. i can attach our tax docs to the vendor packet.

jordan_sales: plan: 1) send vendor packet + tax docs to AP contact (today), 2) ask customer to issue official PO referencing cost center and auth code, 3) once PO received, billing issues invoice referencing PO. if customer requests immediate service payment, sales can propose CC charge with exec approval and then reconcile via invoice once PO arrives.

julia_procurement: added: ask customer if their SAP portal requires a specific invoice filename or PDF metadata (some customers require invoice number in filename). include small checklist in email.

sarah_support: customer replied: they will start vendor registration today but PO may take up to 10 business days. they refused card payment. said they "cannot process pro-forma as payment" — pro-forma only for internal approvals.

alan_billing: update billing task #BILL-4821: set status = waiting_on_customer_po. next check-in in 7 business days.

jordan_sales: flag for account exec — potential delay in payment by up to 2 weeks, may affect revenue recognition. i'll log this in the account tracker.

sarah_support: confirmed — closing thread until we have PO or further instructions from AP. will reopen if they push for exceptions. :white_check_mark:
